AFK-default (DEVIATION from run-cycle Step 3(b) literal wording): the skill says dispatch a TOOL-LESS brain with the emitted prompt inlined. Inlining requires the COORDINATOR to read the emitted prompt, which contains raw fetched web text - and this coordinator holds Bash, which is exactly the injection surface F88 / Part 26 exists to remove. Instead each brain (extract, judge, thesis, implication, narrator) was given READ-ONLY access to its own split prompt files under work/daily-2026-08-04/<seam>-parts/ plus prompt-level bans on Bash/WebFetch/WebSearch, so untrusted text never entered the Bash-holding coordinator's context. This also implements the fix the 2026-07-29 cycle's operatorNotes recommended (that cycle recorded brains falling back to Grep chunking because the emitted user payload is a single 43k-185k-character line the Read tool cannot page). Net security posture is stronger than the literal reading, but it IS a deviation and needs the user's ruling.

MATERIAL GAP THIS CYCLE - AMD Q2 2026 EARNINGS MISSED. AMD's earnings date is the cycle day itself (2026-08-04) and the print lands AFTER market close (~16:00 ET, call 17:00 ET); the gather ran before that. ir.amd.com carried only the 2026-07-08 'will report' advisory. The corpus therefore holds AMD's Q1 actuals plus prior guidance, one quarter stale. The manifest's earnings-window logic correctly rated amd-earnings 'heavy', so this is a TIMING gap, not a targeting failure: a same-day cycle scheduled before the close cannot capture that print. Worth deciding whether the daily schedule should shift later on known earnings dates, or re-run that evening.

CORRECTION SURFACED BY THE THESIS BRAIN: the corpus contains NO MediaTek finding. The HuggingNews headlines that seeded topics T2/T3 said Intel won its first AI-chip order from MediaTek, but the underlying reporting that actually entered the corpus attributes the EMIB-T volume order to GOOGLE (3M+ units for its next TPU, 2028 delivery), with Fortinet as Intel's first external foundry customer. Judgments were made on the findings, not on the headline. A concrete example of why the HuggingNews contract treats stories as leads and never as evidence.

KNOWN LIMITATION (F88, pre-existing, HANDOFF-documented): the harness's Agent tool exposes no per-dispatch tool-allowlist, so the gatherers' no-Bash wall and the brains' read-only rule were enforced by prompt instruction, not structurally.
